sentence_1_it: Il cane andò via come un fulmine.
sentence_1_en: The dog went away like a shot.
sentence_2_it: Io sono all'ospedale. Sono stato colpito da un fulmine.
sentence_2_en: I'm at the hospital. I got struck by lightning.
sentence_3_it: Tom venne colpito da un fulmine e morì.
sentence_3_en: Tom was struck by lightning and died.

sentence_1_it: Pinocchio ebbe molta paura di tuoni e fulmini, ma la fame che sentiva era molto maggiore della sua paura.
sentence_1_en: Pinocchio was greatly afraid of thunder and lightning, but the hunger he felt was far greater than his fear.
sentence_3_it: Quei jet erano più veloci dei fulmini.
sentence_3_en: Those jets were faster than lightning.
